name: kstack
description: Explicit objective, design, implementation, QC, product-experience, per-project Jira provisioning, and post-deploy validation workflows for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Cooperative design, implementation, and QC workflows.
interface.longDescription: KStack challenges objectives, reviews unfamiliar environments and designs with independent reviewers, provisions a repository-owned Jira project/space and backlog when requested, governs shared product experience and brand evidence, interrogates plan changes, enforces post-implementation and post-deploy QC, and offers explicit local PGLite memory with a manually synchronized private body.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $kstack:kstack-init to configure KStack for this repository.
